title: Practice 1: за-: behind, and dropping in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **залезла** is the past tense (feminine) of **залезть** (to climb up (finished action); (also figurative) to get into, to scramble) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **залезать**. past: он зале́з · она зале́зла · оно зале́зло · они зале́зли. — Wiktionary, «залезть» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**за-** — Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way Example: Старушка зашла за угол и исчезла. — The old woman walked behind the corner and disappeared. Prepositional phrases: в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака. Автомашина заезжает за дом. (b) Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: заходить, зайти — в магазин, на почту, к учителю. (c) Dropping in or stopping by to fetch something or someone — заходить, зайти за + Instr.: Я зайду за вами. — I'll stop by to pick you up. Он зашёл за книгой. — He dropped in to pick up the book. Also note the combination of subparagraphs (b) and (c): Он зашёл ко мне за книгой. — He stopped by at my place to pick up the book. Я заехал на почту за письмами. — I stopped by at the post office to get my mail.» — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

Prepositional phrases: в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака. Автомашина заезжает за дом. (b) Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: заходить, зайти — в магазин, на почту, к учителю. (c) Dropping in or stopping by to fetch something or someone — заходить, зайти за + Instr.: Я зайду за вами. — I'll stop by to pick you up. Он зашёл за книгой. — He dropped in to pick up the book. Also note the combination of subparagraphs (b) and (c): Он зашёл ко мне за книгой. — He stopped by at my place to pick up the book. Я заехал на почту за письмами. — I stopped by at the post office to get my mail.» — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
